description: React component implementing a Tic Tac Toe game with state management, UI rendering, and game logic.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Calculates if there's a winner given the current board state.

methods.name: isBoardFull
methods.description: Checks if all cells on the board are filled, indicating a draw if no winner.

methods.name: Game
methods.description: Main React functional component representing the Tic Tac Toe game, managing state and rendering UI.

methods.name: newRound
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new round without resetting scores.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the entire game including the scores as well as the board.

methods.name: cellAriaLabel
methods.description: Generates an accessible aria-label for each cell based on its position and content.
